powers.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
powers.action_summary: Impose penalties and grant all appropriate relief to employees or former employees found to be in violation of this chapter, including compensation, back wages, and equitable relief.
powers.quote: The department shall have the power to impose penalties provided for in this chapter and to grant each and every employee or former employee all appropriate relief. Such relief shall include: (i) for each instance of safe/sick time taken by an employee but unlawfully not compensated by the employer: three times the wages that should have been paid under this chapter or two hundred fifty dollars, whichever is greater; (ii) for each instance of safe/sick time requested by an employee but unlawfully denied by the employer and not taken by the employee or unlawfully conditioned upon searching for or finding a replacement worker, or for each instance an employer requires an employee to work additional hours without the mutual consent of such employer and employee in violation of section 20-915 of this chapter to make up for the original hours during which such employee is absent pursuant to this chapter: five hundred dollars; (iii) for each violation of section 20-918 not including discharge from employment: full compensation including wages and benefits lost, five hundred dollars and equitable relief as appropriate; (iv) for each instance of unlawful discharge from employment: full compensation including wages and benefits lost, two thousand five hundred dollars and equitable relief, including reinstatement, as appropriate; and (v) for each employee covered by an employer's official or unofficial policy or practice of not providing or refusing to allow the use of accrued safe/sick time in violation of section 20-913, five hundred dollars.

powers.action_summary: Destroy forfeited tobacco products or use them for law enforcement purposes, with notice publication.
powers.quote: The commissioner of finance may, within a reasonable time after the forfeiture to the city of such vending machine or receptacle under this section, upon publication of a notice to such effect for at least five successive days, in a newspaper published or circulated in the city, sell such forfeited vending machine or receptacle at public sale and pay the proceeds into the general fund of the city. Tobacco products forfeited to the city under this section shall be destroyed or used for law enforcement purposes, except that tobacco products that violate, or are suspected of violating, federal trademark laws or import laws shall not be used for law enforcement purposes. If the commissioner determines the tobacco products forfeited under this section may not be used for law enforcement purposes, the commissioner of finance must, within a reasonable time after the forfeiture to the city of such cigarettes, upon publication of a notice to such effect for at least five successive days, prior to destruction, in a newspaper published or circulated in the city, destroy such forfeited tobacco products.

powers.quote: If the commissioner determines that exigent circumstances exist such that the continued operation of the business or activity would pose an danger to the public or the health and welfare of the animals in the custody of the business, the commissioner may take any measure authorized by applicable law to enforce an order to cease and desist, subject to a prompt post-enforcement hearing at the environmental control board or any tribunal established within the office of administrative trials and hearings as designated by the commissioner.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Suspend or revoke a pet shop permit upon willful or continued violation of title seventeen, rules, health code, acceptance of bribes, submission of forged documents, or poor moral character.
powers.quote: the commissioner, after due notice and an opportunity to be heard by the environmental control board or any tribunal established within the office of administrative trials and hearings as designated by the commissioner, may suspend or revoke a pet shop permit upon the occurrence of any one or more of the following conditions:
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Suspend a permit without prior hearing in exigent circumstances where continued operation poses danger to the public or animal health and welfare, subject to prompt post-suspension hearing.
powers.quote: Notwithstanding subdivision a of this section, if the commissioner determines that exigent circumstances exist such that the continued operation of a permittee's pet shop would pose a danger to the public or the health and welfare of the animals in the permittee's custody, the commissioner may suspend such permittee's permit subject to a prompt post-suspension hearing before the environmental control board or any tribunal established within the office of administrative trials and hearings as designated by the commissioner.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Issue an order revoking, further suspending, or reinstating a pet shop permit following a hearing, adopting all or part of the tribunal report and recommendations.
powers.quote: Following a hearing required pursuant to this section and the receipt of a copy of the report and recommendations of the tribunal before which such hearing was held, the commissioner may take such action as may be necessary, adopting all or part of the report and recommendations, and may issue an order revoking the permit, further suspending the permit, or reinstating the permit subject to whatever conditions the commissioner deems necessary for the continued safe operation of the permitted business.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Seize revoked permits that are not surrendered by the permittee.
powers.quote: Permits or licenses that are not surrendered in accordance with this section may be seized by any authorized employee or agent of the department or officer of the police department.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Seize animals in pet shops operating without a required permit.
powers.quote: The commissioner or his or her designee may seize any animal in a pet shop operating without a permit required pursuant to section 17-372 of this subchapter.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Impose a fee on pet shop owners representing expenses incurred in impounding seized animals.
powers.quote: The commissioner may impose upon the owner of a pet shop from which an animal is seized pursuant to this section a fee representing expenses incurred in connection with impounding such animal.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules for the production, receipt, acceptance, acquisition, recording, filing, transmission, forwarding, and storage of pet shop recordkeeping and certification by electronic means.
powers.quote: Consistent with the New York state technology law, the department may promulgate rules for the production, receipt, acceptance, acquisition, recording, filing, transmission, forwarding, and storage of such records and documentation by use of electronic means.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Seize animals offered for sale in pet shops in violation of the prohibited sales requirements of section 17-1702.
powers.quote: The commissioner or his or her designee may seize any animal offered for sale in a pet shop where the sale of such animal is prohibited by section 17-1702 of this chapter.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Impose a fee on pet shop owners representing expenses incurred in impounding animals seized for violation of prohibited sales standards.
powers.quote: The commissioner may impose upon the owner of a pet shop from which an animal is seized pursuant to this section a fee representing expenses incurred in connection with the cost of impounding such animal.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules necessary to carry out the provisions of chapter 17 and to ensure the health and safety of animals in pet shops.
powers.quote: The commissioner may promulgate such rules as are necessary to carry out the provisions of this chapter and to ensure the health and safety of any animal in a pet shop.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating pet shops.

powers.agency_full: Department of Buildings
powers.action_summary: Take all actions necessary to implement this local law, including promulgation of rules, on or before the effective date.
powers.quote: the commissioner of buildings may take all actions necessary to implement this local law, including the promulgation of rules, on or before such effective date
powers.deadline_text: on or before such effective date
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city and repealing section 28-1001.2 in relation thereto.

powers.agency_full: Department of Buildings
powers.action_summary: Allow temporary connection of installations to energy sources for testing or operation under temporary certificates of occupancy.
powers.quote: The commissioner shall have the authority to allow the temporary connection of an installation to the sources of energy for the purpose of testing the installation or for use under a temporary certificate of occupancy
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city and repealing section 28-1001.2 in relation thereto.

powers.agency_full: Department of Buildings
powers.action_summary: Accept as-built energy analyses and supporting documents signed and sealed by registered design professionals with less than full examination based on professional certification.
powers.quote: Such signed and sealed documents may be accepted with less than full examination by the department based on the professional certification of the registered design professional
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to conforming the New York city energy conservation code to the New York state energy code with amendments unique to construction in the city and repealing section 28-1001.2 in relation thereto.

powers.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
powers.action_summary: Remove and dispose of publicly accessible collection bins placed on city property, maintained property, public sidewalk, or roadway in accordance with applicable law and rules, thirty days after removal if the owner's name and address are not legible or ascertainable.
powers.quote: If the name and address of the owner of such publicly accessible collection bin are not located on the bin or are not legible, the commissioner may dispose of such bin in accordance with applicable law and rules thirty days after removal.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating publicly accessible collection bins.
powers.committee: Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management

powers.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
powers.action_summary: Dispose of publicly accessible collection bins not claimed within thirty days of mailing notice to the owner, in accordance with applicable law and rules.
powers.quote: If any publicly accessible collection bin is not claimed within thirty days of the mailing of notice to the owner, the commissioner may dispose of such bin in accordance with applicable law and rules.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating publicly accessible collection bins.
powers.committee: Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management

powers.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing payment of removal and storage costs, registration and reporting requirements, procedures for claiming removed bins, and disposal of bins with subsequent failure to collect.
powers.quote: The commissioner may promulgate such rules as are necessary to implement the provisions of this section including, but not limited to, rules relating to: 1. payment, by the owner, of removal and storage costs incurred by the commissioner, 2. registration and reporting requirements for publicly accessible collection bins placed on private property, 3. the procedures for claiming publicly accessible collection bins that are removed by the department, and 4. the disposal of publicly accessible collection bins that have been removed by the department and claimed by an owner in cases where there is a subsequent failure to collect such bins.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to regulating publicly accessible collection bins.
powers.committee: Committee on Sanitation and Solid Waste Management

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Impose inspection fees of two hundred dollars for the third and subsequent complaint-based inspections within a twelve-month period that result in hazardous or immediately hazardous violations, subject to specified exemptions.
powers.quote: the department may impose an inspection fee of two hundred dollars for the third and for each subsequent complaint-based inspection that it performs in such dwelling unit within the same twelve-month period that results in the issuance of a hazardous or immediately hazardous violation
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to inspection fees for certain recurring violations of the housing maintenance code.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: By rule, specify additional hazardous or immediately hazardous violations that are exempt from the inspection fee.
powers.quote: such other hazardous or immediately hazardous violations that the department specifies by rule
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to inspection fees for certain recurring violations of the housing maintenance code.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Increase the inspection fee for inspections performed during October 1 through May 31 by rule.
powers.quote: the department may by rule increase the fee for inspections performed during the period of October first through May thirty-first
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to inspection fees for certain recurring violations of the housing maintenance code.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Set criteria by rule for distressed buildings to participate in the alternative enforcement program, which may include the ratio of violations per dwelling unit, emergency repair charges, and minimum dwelling unit count.
powers.quote: may by rule set criteria for such buildings to participate in the program, which may include, but need not be limited to: the ratio of open hazardous and immediately hazardous violations per dwelling unit, the amount or ratio per dwelling unit of paid or unpaid emergency repair charges and the number of dwelling units that must exist for a building to qualify for participation in the program
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the alternative enforcement program.

powers.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
powers.action_summary: Add to the criteria for excluding buildings from the alternative enforcement program by rule.
powers.quote: The department may by rule add to the criteria set forth in subdivision e of this section relating to which buildings are to be excluded from the program.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the alternative enforcement program.

powers.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules as necessary to effectuate the provisions of chapter 9 of title 20, including establishing civil penalties not exceeding two hundred fifty dollars for rule violations.
powers.quote: The commissioner may promulgate such rules as he or she deems necessary to effectuate the provisions of this chapter, including, but not limited to, establishing civil penalties for the violation of such rules in amounts not exceeding two hundred fifty dollars for any such violation.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring certain qualified transportation benefits.

powers.agency_full: Department of Buildings
powers.action_summary: Take measures necessary for implementation of local law number 141 for the year 2013, including promulgation of rules, prior to the December 31, 2014 effective date.
powers.citation: Section 9 of Local Law 52 of 2014 (amending Section 14 of Local Law 141 of 2013)
powers.quote: The commissioner of buildings may promulgate rules or take other actions for the implementation of this local law prior to such effective date.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend local law number 41 for the year 2012, local law number 79 for the year 2013, local law number 108 for the year 2013, local law number 110 for the year 2013, local law number 100 for the year 2013, local law number 101 for the year 2013, local law number 130 for the year 2013, local law number 141 for the year 2013, local law number 10 for the year 2014, local law number 12 for the year 2014, local law number 13 for the year 2014, local law number 17 for the year 2014 and local law number 18 for the year 2014, in relation to extending the effective date for the 2014 revisions to the New York city construction codes.

powers.agency_full: Department of Small Business Services
powers.action_summary: Establish a program to provide monetary grants to qualified employers for hiring 2014 qualified employees, calculated according to specified wage differentials, payroll taxes, and benefit maintenance costs.
powers.quote: The department may establish a program that shall provide monetary grants to any qualified employer for each 2014 qualified employee hired by such qualified employer in an amount equal to the sum of:
powers.law_title: A Local Law to establish a program in relation to the employment of school bus drivers, attendants, dispatchers and mechanics by qualified employers.

powers.agency_full: Department of Small Business Services
powers.action_summary: Establish a program to provide monetary grants to qualified employers for hiring master seniority lists qualified employees, calculated according to specified wage differentials, payroll taxes, and benefit maintenance costs.
powers.quote: The department may establish a program that shall provide monetary grants to any qualified employer for each master seniority list's qualified employee hired by such qualified employer in an amount equal to the sum of:
powers.law_title: A Local Law to establish a program in relation to the employment of school bus drivers, attendants, dispatchers and mechanics by qualified employers.

powers.agency_full: Campaign Finance Board
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules as necessary to implement and carry out the provisions of the local law regarding campaign spending disclosure.
powers.quote: the campaign finance board may promulgate rules as may be necessary for the purpose of implementing and carrying out the provisions of this local law, prior to its effective date.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring public-facing disclosure of campaign spending.

powers.agency_full: New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules specifying which violations threaten the safety of passengers or other persons for purposes of the persistent violators program's combined points assessment.
powers.quote: only points assessed against a taxicab or for-hire vehicle driver's license for violations that threaten the safety of passengers or any other persons, as specified by rule of the commission, may be applied
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the New York city taxi and limousine commission's critical drivers and persistent violators programs.

powers.agency_full: Department of Finance
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules necessary to effectuate the purposes of the partial abatement program.
powers.quote: The commissioner of finance shall be authorized to promulgate rules necessary to effectuate the purposes of this section.
affected_groups: property owners and administrators of the abatement program
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to a partial abatement of real property taxes on real property that was rebuilt after being seriously damaged by the severe storm that occurred on the twenty-ninth and thirtieth of October, two thousand twelve in a city having a population of one million or more.

powers.agency_full: Department of Buildings
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules necessary for implementation of the insulation requirements for concealed pipes exposed during alteration or repair.
powers.quote: the commissioner of buildings may take such measures as are necessary for its implementation, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such effective date
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to requiring insulation of existing concealed pipes exposed during alteration or repair.

powers.agency_full: Department of Finance
powers.action_summary: Complete the assessment rolls using estimated rates and collect tax sums according to law if the Council has not fixed tax rates by June 18, 2014.
powers.quote: the commissioner of finance shall pursuant to such subdivision be authorized to complete the assessment rolls using estimated rates and to collect the sums therein mentioned according to law.
powers.deadline_text: if the Council has not fixed the tax rates for the ensuing fiscal year on or before June 18, 2014
powers.law_title: A Local Law in relation to the date of submission by the Mayor of the proposed executive budget and budget message, the date of submission by the Borough Presidents of recommendations in response to the Mayor's executive budget, the date of publication of a report by the director of the independent budget office analyzing the executive budget, the date by which the Council hearings pertaining to the executive budget shall conclude, the date by which if the expense budget has not been adopted, the expense budget and tax rate adopted as modified for the current fiscal year shall be deemed to have been extended for the new fiscal year until such time as a new expense budget has been adopted, the date by which if a capital budget and a capital program have not been adopted, the unutilized portion of all prior capital appropriations shall be deemed reappropriated, the date of submission by the Mayor of an estimate of the probable amount of receipts, the date by which any person or organizat...

powers.agency_full: Office of the Mayor
powers.action_summary: Authorize provision of health insurance coverage for surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children of specified deceased employees of the fleet services division of the police department, roadway repair and maintenance division of the department of transportation, bureau of wastewater treatment and bureau of water supply of the department of environmental protection, and traffic enforcement district of the transportation bureau of the police department.
powers.quote: The mayor may, in his or her discretion, authorize the provision of such health insurance coverage for the surviving spouses, domestic partners and children of employees of the fleet services division of the police department who died on or after October first, nineteen hundred ninety-eight and before April thirtieth, nineteen hundred ninety-nine; the surviving spouses, domestic partners and children of employees of the roadway repair and maintenance division of the department of transportation who died on or after September first, two thousand five and before September twenty-eighth, two thousand five; the surviving spouses, domestic partners and children of employees of the bureau of wastewater treatment of the department of environmental protection who died on or after January eighth, two thousand nine and before January tenth, two thousand nine or the surviving spouses, domestic partners and children of employees of the bureau of water supply of such agency who died on or after February second, two thousand fourteen and before February fourth, two thousand fourteen; and the surviving spouses, domestic partners and children of employees of the traffic enforcement district of the transportation bureau of the police department who died on or after November first, two thousand thirteen and before December first, two thousand thirteen
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to health insurance coverage for surviving family members of certain deceased employees of the department of environmental protection.
powers.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

powers.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
powers.action_summary: Exercise all powers relating to receipt, investigation, and resolution of complaints regarding earned sick time, and conduct investigations regarding violations upon the commissioner's own initiative.
powers.citation: NYC Charter § 2203(e), as amended by Section 1
powers.quote: The commissioner shall have all powers as set forth in chapter 8 of title 20 of the administrative code relating to the receipt, investigation, and resolution of complaints thereunder regarding earned sick time, and the power to conduct investigations regarding violations of such chapter upon his or her own initiative.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the New York city charter and the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the provision of sick time earned by employees, and section 7 of local law number 46 for the year 2013, relating to such sick time, in relation to the effective date of such local law, and to repeal section 6 of local law number 46 for the year 2013, relating to a determination of the Independent Budget Office.
powers.committee: Committee on Civil Service and Labor

powers.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
powers.action_summary: Promulgate rules necessary for the implementation of the animal abuse registry chapter.
powers.quote: The commissioner may promulgate rules necessary for the implementation of this chapter.
affected_groups: persons convicted of animal abuse crimes
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to creating an animal abuse registry.

powers.agency_full: Department of Environmental Protection
powers.action_summary: Amend or supplement the list of required trainings by rule when new trainings in hazardous environmental remediation become available.
powers.quote: Should new trainings in hazardous environmental remediation become available, the department after consultation with the department of health and mental hygiene, may by rule amend or supplement such list.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.

powers.agency_full: Department of Environmental Protection
powers.action_summary: Audit training programs provided by approved training providers to ensure they meet departmental standards.
powers.quote: The commissioner may audit training programs provided by approved training providers to ensure that such training programs meet the standards of the department.
powers.law_title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to the creation of a voluntary master environmental hazard remediation technician registration program.
